presentation_policy.anchor_definition: Capture one UTC Instant when creating a fresh demo dataset or performing an explicitly approved demo reset. Resolve every relative timestamp from this single anchor and persist as timestamptz.
presentation_policy.field_encoding: Materialize collection_deadline as max(demo_epoch + offset_seconds, not_before). created_at and updated_at remain demo_epoch. Presentation: 2026-11-03 10:00 WAT; deadline floor: 2026-11-05 18:00 WAT.
presentation_policy.repeat_execution: Ordinary startup/rerun must preserve persisted dates and interactions. Only an explicit approved reset may establish a new epoch for these demo records. Stable IDs prevent duplicate records.
presentation_policy.expiry: collection_deadline is both the collection cutoff and expiry eligibility deadline. No separate expiry field or automatic status-expiry scheduler exists.
presentation_policy.note: The absolute presentation floor applies only on initial insertion. Ordinary reruns preserve persisted deadlines and interactions. After the floor, relative offsets continue to provide future deadlines. These fictional demo windows are not food safety or shelf-life claims.

donors.reuse_policy: Reuse only if deterministic ID, exact demo email and DONOR role agree. Preserve existing password hash and created_at. Proposed display_name applies only to this verified demo account. Abort on identity conflict; never modify non-demo users.
